title: Create: cardboard conductors
description: cardboard conductors from steam and rails
body:
Create: Cardboard Conductors is a resource pack that gives a humorous and charming twist to the Create mod: steam and rail's conductors. With this pack, the rail conductors are transformed into cardboard versions, making them look like they’ve been pieced together by hand out of cardboard.

Create: Cardboard Conductors keeps everything functional but adds a fun visual flair, making it a unique way to enjoy the mod with a new, quirky look for your steam and rail systems.
